families.title: Six product families, {{products}} datasheets
families.lede: Everything inside a panel, from the busbar to the screw that holds the rail. Every range has a datasheet you can download.

process.title: Every product starts in our own plant
process.lede: Casting, extrusion, pressing, moulding and machining are done in house, so quality is part of the process, not an inspection at the end.

steps.title: Material
steps.text: Brass, copper, steel, SS304 and SS316, aluminium, polyamide, PVC, DMC, SMC and epoxy.

steps.title: Form
steps.text: Power presses, rolling and shearing, compression and injection moulding, PVC extrusion.

steps.title: Machine
steps.text: CNC milling, drilling and turning to drawing, plus conventional machines.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Tin electroplating, nickel chrome and zinc plating, natural or coloured finishes.

steps.title: Check
steps.text: A documented quality policy under ISO 9001 and ISO 45001, RoHS compliant ranges.

steps.title: Ship
steps.text: Packed and dispatched to export markets on five continents.

items.name: Metering and protection

items.text: Test terminal blocks let engineers test meters, relays and instrument transformers on site without disconnecting the load.

items.name: Rail and transport

items.text: Earth rods, clamps and air terminals complete an earthing or lightning system, with cable glands and ducts for the wiring.
